summary: The earlier no-comparison reason still holds against primary sources (2026-11-16). The only file in Figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.22065005 is Supplementary_data_2.xlsx, and its MD5 matches the Figshare-supplied value. It has 4 gene-level DE tables: IP/SN Pairwise (HFD Sham vs HFD ORX/GDX) and IP/SN Ordinal (a three-group ChowSham/HFDSham/HFDGDX trend), plus 16 GSEA sheets. GEO supplementary files are TPM and raw-count matrices only. No author table gives the registered Sham-HFD vs Sham-Chow IP effect. The contrast and effect definitions are incompatible, so no author-concordance-v2 comparison is valid. No metrics were computed and no ledger changes are proposed.
